title: Unified Latent Space for Understanding and Generation via Semantic Auto-encoder
author: Li, Author1, Author2
summary: The Semantic Auto-encoder (S-AE) creates a unified latent space that improves both image understanding and generation by preserving fine details and semantic information. Compared to other models, S-AE trains faster, reconstructs images more accurately, and works well across different datasets and backbones. This approach bridges the gap between representation learning and image synthesis, enabling better visual quality and faster convergence.
